basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer based in Austin, Texas. Biking is my primary mode of transport and my favorite hobby. I spend weekends exploring trails around the city and tinkering with my bike. When I'm not biking, I hit the gym for strength training or dive into new technologies and games. I work remotely, so my online hours are flexible, usually evenings and late nights. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to pursue my interests. I'm a tech enthusiast and love discussing the latest gadgets and software.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the University of Texas and work as a full-stack developer. My passion for biking started in college, where I joined a cycling club. I learned about bike mechanics through online courses and community workshops. My interest in technology keeps me updated on the latest trends and software developments.
